amends.scope_of_supersession: its 15m feed-divergence LIMITATION only; its research/diagnostic timeframe registry is unchanged

superseded_limitation.why_the_premise_failed: the premise (bars is structurally daily) is TRUE and still proven; the inference from it was wrong, because this comparison runs the canonical engine on BOTH sides and never needed a legacy T column — and a legacy 15m OHLC store existed all along

one_d_diagnostic_demoted.why_it_matters: direct 15m divergence is 5.4461% against 2.4% at 1D, so carrying the 1D figure across would have HALVED the real effect; the no-imputation rule was load-bearing, not bookkeeping

position_decomposition.why_recorded: the registered historical study is opening-hour anchored on M1->M2 / M2->M3 / M3->M4, and agreement is markedly uneven across exactly those positions
position_decomposition.interpretation: X_SIDE_FACT_ONLY — no outcome interpretation is attached

attribution.what_would_confirm: joining a split / spin-off / symbol-history authority to the differing rows at row level
attribution.observation: ~1.1% of matched bars differ by more than one cent, clustering the same way they did at 1D

my_defect_recorded.defect: the first run of the 15m diagnostic matched ZERO bars and sealed anyway
my_defect_recorded.cause: legacy timestamps are datetime64[us] and were divided as if nanoseconds, yielding SECONDS against the store's MILLISECONDS — a 1000x unit mismatch
my_defect_recorded.severity: FAIL_OPEN — a diagnostic that matches nothing is a harness defect, not a measurement
my_defect_recorded.retained_status: INVALID_ZERO_SUPPORT / SUPERSEDED — not deleted, not overwritten
my_defect_recorded.fix: explicit conversion through datetime64[ms] so the unit cannot depend on the source resolution

why_no_rebuild: the diagnostic changed no engine, no port hash, no config and no Massive input semantics; T production remains byte-valid
